steps.label: The unit
steps.why: Each nephron makes urine on its own from start to finish, which is what makes it both the structural and the functional unit.
common_mistakes: Naming the kidney tubule only. The unit is the whole nephron.
Naming the glomerulus. That is one part of a nephron.
steps.memory_tip: One nephron does the whole job by itself.
steps.margin_note: Name the unit, then its two parts.
lines: The nephron is the structural and
Each nephron has two parts, Bowman's

steps.label: Its two types
steps.why: The two types differ in how far the loop of Henle dips into the medulla, which decides how concentrated the urine can be.
steps.memory_tip: Cortical stays high; juxtamedullary reaches deep.

lines.text: The two types are cortical and juxtamedullary

insider_note: Two questions in one. Name the nephron, then name both types — a student who names only the nephron gets one mark.
